description: ciris-binary-manifest/1 known answers (FSD-008 §6, CC 3.1.2.1 as accepted 2026-11-22): valid blobs with and without the inline table, functions_root per leaf count, and refusals by token.
merkle_rule: CC 3.1.2.1 ("A locale manifest is a Merkle tree of one leaf per locale"; "Locale ordering: ... Padding: repeat the last leaf to the next power of two"): leaf SHA-256(0x00 || leaf); node SHA-256(0x01 || left || right); a non-power-of-two count padded by repeating the last leaf to the next power of two. merkle_tree: generic over leaf byte strings in the order given. function_tables: leaves in name byte order, each CDE({name, offset, size, hash}).
